text:
Alex: Quick async — night bridge checklist + alert summaries for handover.
Alex: What I did: fixed autoscaler job that was causing backpressure on the batcher, rolled kv-cache patch to canary (3 pods), ran synthetic load against eu-west embeddings.
Alex: Blockers: still seeing intermittent 504s on long-gen path when seq > 2048; suspect batcher head-of-line blocking. Logs noisy, pasted snippet below.
Alex: Today: increase batcher CPU on canary to 2, dig into kv-evict patterns, prepare a 5-min summary for morning SRE sync.
Priya: Ack — saw the canary roll. Memory stable there. Can you share the k8s deployment hash and canary pod names? @Jamie fyi on the 504 pattern.
Alex: deployment hash: `abc123def`
Alex: canary pods: `inference-batcher-canary-0`, `-1`, `-2`
Alex: logs: ```
2026-03-18T02:11:07Z batcher INFO queue_size=1987 enqueue_time_ms=12
2026-03-18T02:11:08Z batcher WARN queue_overflow=true dropped=12
2026-03-18T02:11:09Z kv-evict INFO eviction_rate=120/s thrash=true
2026-03-18T02:11:11Z http ERROR path=/v1/generate status=504 latency_ms=30004
```
Jamie: Those `queue_overflow=true` lines match what I saw in the last patch. Quick mitigation idea: bump `batcher_queue_size` 2048 -> 4096 and add backpressure metric so we can auto-scale earlier. I'll sketch a PR.
Jamie: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/987 (small change + metric export)
Ryan: Noted. I observed error budget burn in eu-west from 02:10–02:20 — caller svc-search started using fallback model. I rolled back the routing rule that pushed burst traffic to smaller instances, that dropped errors back down.
Sam: I'm oncall tomorrow morning 06:00–14:00 UTC. If you want me to watch the canary after the PR lands I can be on deck.
Alex: @Sam please watch the canary if PR merges before 05:00 UTC. If 504 rate > 0.5% over 5m, open rollback and ping #eng-sre-oncall.
Priya: Small ask — can we add a one-liner in the PR description about observability dashboard to check for queue_overflow? makes handoffs easier.
Jamie: Good call. Adding dashboard links + screenshot.
deploy-bot: deploy started: inference-batcher-canary -> image redwood/inference:canary-20260318-1 (rolling) :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: 3/3 updated, 0 failed.
ops-bot: alert summary (02:00-03:00 UTC): `batcher.queue_overflow` fired 4x (eu-west), `http.504_rate` peaked at 0.9% for 12m, `kv.evict_thrash` fired 3x. No Pager after mitigation.
Alex: Thanks all. I filed a tiny follow-up ticket to add the backpressure metric + dashboard (OPS-1247). Will post updates if the PR changes metrics. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks — leaving a note in morning sync.
Sam: I'll standby and do a 10m check after the merge.
Jamie: PR queued for merge after CI.
Alex: End of thread — ping if anything urgent overnight.
